storageMode: metadata only; official listing and Amphenol business URLs retained

4-3-10-connector-series.name: 4.3-10 Connector Series
4-3-10-connector-series.description: Amphenol RF offers a full range of 4.3-10 connectors and adapters, which are engineered for the wireless market and are ideal for applications requiring low passive intermodulation, or PIM.

between-series-adapters.name: Between-Series Adapters
between-series-adapters.description: Designed with RF performance in mind, SV Microwave's between-series adapters ensure optimal signal integrity and performance. Between-series adapters support transitions between various connector series, accommodating the diverse needs of RF and microwave systems, all while maintaining a compact footprint.

between-series-flange-mount-adapters.name: Between-Series Flange Mount Adapters
between-series-flange-mount-adapters.description: SV Microwave’s Between-Series Flange Mount Adapters are engineered to deliver outstanding reliability and durability in demanding test and measurement environments. Performing up to 65 GHz, these adapters provide an exceptionally secure, high-integrity RF connection. Offering a versatile range of configurations, including SMA, SMP, and SMPM, alongside our proprietary Threaded SMPM and QuarterBack® techs.

between-series-rf-adapters.name: Between-Series RF Adapters
between-series-rf-adapters.description: Amphenol CDI Between-Series RF Adapters ensure dependable cross-compatibility between RF systems, delivering high-performance solutions for mission-critical applications. Ideal for aerospace, military, space, and industrial environments, these adapters feature low insertion loss, strong shielding against interference, and precision-machined construction for long-term durability.

candlestick-panel-connectors.name: Candlestick Panel Connectors
candlestick-panel-connectors.description: Engineered with precision machining and high-quality materials, these connectors ensure superior shielding, low insertion loss, and resistance to harsh environmental conditions. The candlestick design allows for optimized connectivity and easy integration into panel-mounted RF applications, making them ideal for mission-critical systems.

coaxial-fixed-attenuators.name: Coaxial Fixed Attenuators
coaxial-fixed-attenuators.description: Amphenol RF attenuators are designed to offer flat attenuation over the designated frequency range and feature a microwave grade resistor that consistently reduces power. Hex flats on the body allow this attenuator to be easily torqued to the mating connector.

coaxial-inserts.name: Coaxial Inserts
coaxial-inserts.description: Size 8 coaxial inserts for DIN and D-Sub applications. Available for common flexible coaxial cables.

compression-connectors.name: Compression Connectors
compression-connectors.description: SINGLE-PIECE COMPRESSION TYPE SURFACE MOUNT CONNECTORS Amphenol Communications Solutions offers compression-type surface mount connectors to provide power and signal connection between either two PCB modules or one PCB and an electrical module. The single-piece small footprint solution brings cost and space savings to the design of smaller and more economical consumer electronic devices.

d-sub-hybrid-connectors.name: D-Sub Hybrid Connectors
d-sub-hybrid-connectors.description: HYBRID D-SUBMINIATURE CONNECTORS Mating interface according to MIL C24308 Current rating of 7.5A for signal and 40A max. for power Endures temperatures up to 260°C Contact resistance less than 5mOhms Up to 18 configurations of Signal, Power, and Coax contacts Machined signal contacts are fixed in the insulator

edge-mount-pcb-connectors.name: Edge Mount PCB Connectors
edge-mount-pcb-connectors.description: Amphenol CDI Edge Mount PCB Connectors provide high-performance RF signal transmission with a secure and space-efficient PCB mounting design. Engineered for aerospace, military, space, and industrial applications, these connectors offer low insertion loss, excellent impedance control, and superior shielding to ensure reliable connectivity in high-frequency environments.

ez-1200-nmc-2.name: EZ-1200-NMC-2
ez-1200-nmc-2.description: is a Type N male (plug), straight EZ connector for LMR®-1200 cables. It features crimp-style outer contacts, spring finger inner contacts, and a no-braid trim to prevent FOD. BeCu pins ensure strong contact in cold, high-vibration conditions. Durable and weatherproof, it meets MIL-C-39012 specs and is ideal for long, high-power, low-loss RF cable runs.

ez-195-qm-x.name: EZ-195-QM-X
ez-195-qm-x.description: is a QMA male (plug), straight EZ connector for LMR®-195 cables. It features crimp-style outer contacts, spring finger inner contacts, and a no-braid trim to eliminate FOD. BeCu pins ensure strong contact in cold, high-vibration conditions. The QMA’s snap-on coupling enables quick installs, dense packaging, and low RF leakage—ideal for high-performance systems.

field-replaceable-panel-connectors.name: Field Replaceable Panel Connectors
field-replaceable-panel-connectors.description: Amphenol CDI Field Replaceable Panel Connectors are designed for high-performance RF applications, offering easy maintenance, secure panel mounting, and exceptional signal integrity. These connectors enable quick and efficient replacement without the need for extensive rework, making them ideal for aerospace, military, space, and industrial applications where system uptime is critical.

filter-rf-connectors.name: Filter RF Connectors
filter-rf-connectors.description: Amphenol's BNC RF connectors provide optimum capacitive decoupling between the connector body and the mounting panel, by harmlessly dissipating EMI (Electromagnetic Interference) on the coaxial shield to the chassis ground through capacitors, while not affecting the DC and power supply frequencies.

grounding-blocks.name: Grounding Blocks
grounding-blocks.description: Amphenol CDI Grounding Blocks are essential components for protecting RF systems from electrical surges and ensuring reliable signal performance. Designed to provide a low-resistance path to ground, these blocks help prevent damage caused by static discharge, lightning strikes, and power surges.

high-performance-rf-adapters.name: High Performance RF Adapters
high-performance-rf-adapters.description: SV Microwave has released a line of high-performance adapters capable of excellent signal performance up to 65 GHz. These between-series adapters are configured with a reliable, easily-calibrated, and consistent threaded interface on one end and a convenient high-density push-on interface on the other, making them ideal for various applications.

high-speed-edge-launch-pcb-connectors.name: High Speed Edge Launch PCB Connectors
high-speed-edge-launch-pcb-connectors.description: Amphenol SV Microwave offers a complete line of extreme frequency (DC - 100 GHz) coaxial / RF edge launch PCB connectors that meet the need for high-performing, highly reliable precision connectors. Current RF test connector configurations include single and multiport 2.92 mm, 2.4 mm, 1.85 mm, SMA, SMP, SMPM, and SMPS variations.

ib-086.name: IB-086
ib-086.description: InstaBend® -086 cable is a flexible, coaxial microwave assembly designed for interconnects between RF circuit cards, modules and enclosure panels. The cable can be bent very closely behind the connector, simplifying cable routing.

in-series-adapters.name: In-Series Adapters
in-series-adapters.description: SV Microwave's In-Series Adapters offer top-tier connectivity within specific connector series, covering a range of connector series such as SMA, 2.92mm, 2.4mm, 1.85mm, SMP, SMPM, and SMPS. These adapters offer unparalleled performance and reliability. One notable In-Series product is SV’s bulkhead hermetic adapter, providing a robust solution that eliminates ingress from harsh elements.

litetouch-solderless-pcb-connectors.name: LiteTouch Solderless PCB Connectors
litetouch-solderless-pcb-connectors.description: SV now offers a complete line of high frequency coaxial / surface mount PCB connectors that meet the industry need for high performing, highly reliable solderless connectors for precision thin substrate mounting. As frequencies increase and board substrates become thinner, the standard solderless PCB compression mount connectors can create undesirable results on thin (< .010”) dielectric PCB.

mcx-connector-series.name: MCX Connector Series
mcx-connector-series.description: The MCX (Micro Coaxial) series is a 50 Ω series with broadband capability ranging from DC to 6 GHz. In addition, the MCX series features secure, fast and easy snap-on/ snap-off coupling.

n-type-connector-series.name: N-Type Connector Series
n-type-connector-series.description: N-Type connectors are designed to satisfy the need for a durable, weatherproof, medium-size RF connector with consistent performance through 11 GHz. Our N-Type connectors feature threaded coupling mechanisms and are fully interchangeable with N-Type connectors made to the MIL-C-39012 specification. These connectors are used in all systems where excellent RF and mechanical performance is critical.

panel-mount-connectors.name: Panel Mount Connectors
panel-mount-connectors.description: SV Microwave's panel mount connectors are designed for robust and dependable RF connections. They are built to endure harsh environmental conditions and provide excellent durability during mating. These connectors are perfect for applications that require panel mounting, ensuring a secure RF connection in demanding environments.

precision-test-cables.name: Precision Test Cables
precision-test-cables.description: Amphenol RF offers pre-configured RF test cables designed for high-performance applications requiring minimal insertion and return loss. They are ideal for test and measurement applications and each assembly is tested to ensure electrical and mechanical performance.

push-on-rf-adapters.name: Push-On RF Adapters
push-on-rf-adapters.description: Ideal for aerospace, military, space, and industrial applications, these adapters offer low insertion loss, strong shielding against interference, and mechanical durability. Their push-on design allows for easy installation and removal, making them perfect for high-density systems and applications requiring frequent connections.

qma-connector-series.name: QMA Connector Series
qma-connector-series.description: The QMA connector is a quick disconnect version of the SMA connector and shares the same internal construction, which allows the connector to have excellent performance up to 6 GHz.

qn-connectors.name: QN Connectors
qn-connectors.description: Amphenol RF’s QN connector is a quick disconnect version of the N-Type connector with similar internal construction, which enables fast and easy matings with minimum space requirements.

radio-frequency-connectors-rf-connectors.name: (Radio Frequency Connectors) RF Connectors
radio-frequency-connectors-rf-connectors.description: Amphenol LTW's RF connector (radio frequency connector) is an electrical connector designed to work at radio frequencies in the multi-megahertz range. RF connectors are typically used with coaxial cables and are designed to maintain the shielding that the coaxial design offers. Available in SMA【Quick guide: https://amphenolltw.com/down.php?supp_download=105】

removal-tools.name: Removal Tools
removal-tools.description: Elevate your RF connector handling experience with SV Microwaves advanced removal tools, crafted for precision and efficiency. From the 3mm Bullet Removal Tool to the SMPM Male Shroud Driver, each product is designed with ergonomic handles to ensure user comfort in confined spaces. SV Microwaves' comprehensive inventory includes specialized tools for various connector types, including SMP, SMPM, and SMPS.

rf-and-microwave-short.name: RF and Microwave Short
rf-and-microwave-short.description: SV Microwave offers a range of shorts designed for RF and microwave applications. These components short the signal path to ground and can help protect a system from electrostatic discharge. With precision design, customizable options, and compatibility with various connectors, reliable solutions for maintaining optimal performance in microwave systems.

rf-attenuators.name: RF Attenuators
rf-attenuators.description: SV Microwave’s attenuators are quality RF and microwave components engineered to reduce power without compromising signal integrity. Supporting a wide frequency range of up to 40 GHz and available in various attenuation (dB) values, these attenuators are ideal for telecommunications, aerospace, and defense applications. With exceptional performance and compatibility with different connectors.

rf-jumpers.name: RF Jumpers
rf-jumpers.description: Amphenol CDI RF Jumpers are designed for high-performance signal transmission, providing reliable connectivity with minimal signal loss. Engineered for aerospace, military, space, and industrial applications, these jumpers offer exceptional electrical performance, durability, and flexibility to meet the demands of mission-critical RF systems. Available in a variety of configurations.

sma-and-rp-sma-connector-series.name: SMA and RP-SMA Connector Series
sma-and-rp-sma-connector-series.description: Using a threaded interface, SMA 50 Ohm connectors are semi-precision units that provide excellent electrical performance from DC to 18 GHz and outstanding mechanical durability.

smp-and-smpm-edge-lock-pcb-connectors.name: SMP and SMPM Edge Lock PCB Connectors
smp-and-smpm-edge-lock-pcb-connectors.description: SV Microwave’s newly expanded Edge Lock PCB Connector introduces small form, push-on SMP and SMPM connectors. Designed for high-frequency performance up to 65 GHz, these edge launch connectors deliver minimal Insertion Loss and low reflections without burdensome assembly techniques for reflow. Their fixture-less, conical-leg design ensures secure PCB edge retention.

smp-connector-series.name: SMP Connector Series
smp-connector-series.description: The SMP interface is a subminiature interface in the same scale as MMCX connectors but offers a frequency range of DC to 40 GHz. It is commonly used in miniaturized high frequency coaxial modules and is offered in both push-on and snap-on mating styles.

smpm-smps-vita-67-3-rf-terminations.name: SMPM/SMPS VITA 67.3 RF Terminations
smpm-smps-vita-67-3-rf-terminations.description: This line of VITA 67.3 contact terminations prevents RF signals from reflecting back and causing damage to your embedded system. Now available for both SMPM and SMPS series. SV Microwave’s VITA product line is the latest addition to the RF / coaxial section of the VPX platform.

smps-spring-bullets.name: SMPS Spring Bullets
smps-spring-bullets.description: SV Microwave’s newest spring loaded bullet product line employs an SMPS RF interface to maximize density and high frequency in applications up to 32 GHz. These spring loaded bullets have been designed for repeatable RF performance under all states of compression by solving axial and radial misalignment issues when fully mated.

solder-pot-panel-connectors.name: Solder Pot Panel Connectors
solder-pot-panel-connectors.description: Amphenol CDI Solder Pot Panel Connectors are designed for secure and reliable RF signal transmission, offering a robust solder termination for optimal electrical performance. These panel-mount connectors provide low-loss connectivity in aerospace, military, space, and industrial applications, ensuring superior durability and long-term reliability.

surface-mount-pcb-connectors.name: Surface Mount PCB Connectors
surface-mount-pcb-connectors.description: Amphenol CDI Surface Mount PCB Connectors provide reliable RF signal transmission with a compact, low-profile design for direct PCB integration. These connectors offer excellent electrical performance, making them ideal for aerospace, military, space, and industrial applications where board space and high-frequency integrity are critical.

termination-components.name: Termination Components
termination-components.description: SV Microwave's termination components are essential elements in RF and microwave systems, designed to absorb and dissipate signals effectively. Terminations prevent signal reflections and maintain impedance matching, contributing to signal integrity. SV Microwave offers a variety of termination components with different power handling capabilities, frequency ranges, and connector options.

termination-tools-for-rf-connectors.name: Termination Tools for RF Connectors
termination-tools-for-rf-connectors.description: Amphenol RF offers a full line of termination tooling to meet your specific production requirements. All tools meet Amphenol’s stringent design and quality requirements and provide a consistent and reliable crimp each and every time, thereby ensuring the integrity of the connector termination.

threaded-rf-adapters.name: Threaded RF Adapters
threaded-rf-adapters.description: Amphenol CDI Threaded RF Adapters provide secure, vibration-resistant connections for high-frequency signal transmission. Designed for aerospace, military, space, and industrial applications, these adapters ensure low insertion loss, excellent shielding, and long-term reliability in demanding environments.

two-hole-flange-adapters.name: Two Hole Flange Adapters
two-hole-flange-adapters.description: Amphenol SV Microwave released 2-hole in-, and between-series flange mount adapters. These offerings include in-series threaded (SMA / 2.92mm / 2.4mm) as well as between-series push-on (SMP / SMPM) to threaded (2.92mm / 2.4mm) options. Additionally, these new adapters come with two screws for fast and easy installation. With so many configurations available, there is a solution f

uhf-connector-series.name: UHF Connector Series
uhf-connector-series.description: Originally intended for use as a video connector in radar applications, UHF coaxial connectors are general purpose units developed for use in low frequency systems from 0.6 - 300 MHz.

vita-contacts-and-connectors.name: VITA Contacts and Connectors
vita-contacts-and-connectors.description: SV Microwave offers a range of VITA 67.1, 67.2, and 67.3 contacts and connectors. We offer female and male contacts and connectors in all three VITA 67 series: SMPM, SMPS, and NanoRF. A select range of these connectors and contacts is SOSA aligned as well.
